definitions.explanation: Describing something that contains a lot of specific information or is explained in depth.
Describing someone who knows a lot about a particular subject. Used with に to indicate the topic of expertise.

examples.japanese: {詳|くわ}しい⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いします→お願い：10299_onegai⟧。
examples.english: Please give me a detailed explanation.

examples.english: A friend who knows a lot about food told me about a good restaurant.

notes:
Has two main uses: describing detailed information and describing a knowledgeable person.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {詳|くわ}しい + noun ({詳|くわ}しい⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ = detailed information)
- 〜に{詳|くわ}しい (knowledgeable about ~)

FORMS:
- Adverb: {詳|くわ}しく ({詳|くわ}しく⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = explain in detail)
- Negative: {詳|くわ}しくない
- Past: {詳|くわ}しかった

SIMILAR ADJECTIVES AND RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧ - fine, minute (focuses on small parts)
- ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧ - details (noun, more formal)
- ⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧ - concrete, specific (about the kind of information, not its amount)
- ⟦{大|おお}まか→大まか：07664_oomaka⟧ - rough, broad-brush: the opposite of sense 1

USAGE:
- Sense 2 takes に, never を: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧に{詳|くわ}しい. ⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧ works with verbs of knowing but not with this adjective.
- Calling someone 〜に{詳|くわ}しい is a compliment short of claiming ⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧ (professional expertise), so it is safe to use about a hobby or side interest.
- {詳|くわ}しくない is the standard modest disclaimer before giving an opinion — it softens rather than refuses.

REGISTER:
- The adverb {詳|くわ}しく is everyday; ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧に belongs to written and business Japanese.
